messages:
maria-sr-sales: Quick ask from GovBank procurement: can Redwood support an air-gapped POC with signed incremental patches, no outbound telemetry, and a documented rollback? Need answers for the RFP.

ali-solutions: Yes. Two options: we provide minibundles (delta-friendly) signed by Redwood, or customer-signed manifests if they supply an HSM/KMS pubkey. Both are self-contained.

devon-eng: Minibundle format: chunked tar + manifest.json + bundle.sha256. Resumable transfers supported. Apply is offline only; example verify: `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256 && ./verify-manifest --pubkey govbank.pem bundle.sig`.

sophie-security: One-liner for questionnaire: "Yes 1 Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) and can operate with customer-held keys or our HSM-backed signing service; detailed key-injection runbook available."

ops-engr: Pricing pointers: POC support ~ $25k (2 wks eng). Offline signed-bundle subscription (4 patches/yr + hotfix SLA) starting ~$20k/yr. Customer HSM integration: $6k setup. No telemetry in offline bundles.

maria-sr-sales: Perfect. I'll add those lines to the response. If they require AES-256 encrypted bundles, ask procurement how they want keys exchanged (sneakernet vs wrapped envelopes).

ali-solutions: Noted. I'll prepare a short runbook snippet and attach specimen manifest to the ticket.
